ValidationRule.description: BDM profile will not be able to reject case if status is other then 'Submit for approval'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rejected"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Not Submitted for Approval")), $Profile.Name = "BDM" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The case has been submitted , so you cannot change the status to "Rejected" at this stage.
